name: Customer Health Dashboard
description: Customer health monitoring and churn prevention

cards.name: Healthy Customers
cards.description: Percentage of customers with health score above threshold

native.query:
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(CASE WHEN health_score > {{health_threshold}} THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
         NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1
    ) as healthy_percentage
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
  AND updated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]

cards.name: At-Risk Customers
cards.description: Number of customers with health score below 40

native.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as at_risk_customers
FROM customer_health 
WHERE health_score < 40 
  AND status = 'active'
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
  AND updated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]

cards.name: Average Customer Health
cards.description: Average health score across all active customers

native.query:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(health_score)::numeric, 1) as avg_health
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
  AND updated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]

cards.name: Customer Satisfaction
cards.description: Average CSAT score from recent surveys

native.query:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(csat_score)::numeric, 1) as avg_csat
FROM customer_feedback 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND csat_score IS NOT NULL
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR customer_segment = {{customer_segment}})

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN health_score >= 80 THEN 'Excellent (80-100)'
        WHEN health_score >= 60 THEN 'Good (60-79)'
        WHEN health_score >= 40 THEN 'Fair (40-59)'
        ELSE 'Poor (0-39)'
    END as health_category,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(health_score)::numeric, 1) as avg_score
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
  AND updated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
GROUP BY health_category
ORDER BY MIN(health_score) DESC

cards.name: Churn Risk Factors
cards.description: Primary factors contributing to customer churn risk

native.query:
SELECT 
    churn_risk_factor,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(health_score)::numeric, 1) as avg_health,
    ROUND(
      (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ())::numeric, 1
    ) as percentage
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active' 
  AND health_score < 50
  AND churn_risk_factor IS NOT NULL
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
  AND updated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
GROUP BY churn_risk_factor
ORDER BY customer_count DESC

cards.name: Health Trends
cards.description: Customer health score trends over time

native.query:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('week', updated_at) as week,
    ROUND(AVG(health_score)::numeric, 1) as avg_health,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN health_score < 40 THEN 1 END) as at_risk_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN health_score >= 80 THEN 1 END) as excellent_count
FROM customer_health 
WHERE updated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND status = 'active'
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', updated_at)
ORDER BY week

cards.name: Intervention Success Rate
cards.description: Success rate of customer success interventions

native.query:
SELECT 
    intervention_type,
    COUNT(*) as total_interventions,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN outcome = 'successful' THEN 1 END) as successful,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(CASE WHEN outcome = 'successful' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric, 1
    ) as success_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(health_score_improvement)::numeric, 1) as avg_improvement
FROM customer_interventions 
WHERE created_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR customer_segment = {{customer_segment}})
GROUP BY intervention_type
ORDER BY success_rate DESC

cards.name: Customer Lifetime Value by Health
cards.description: LTV correlation with customer health scores

native.query:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN health_score >= 80 THEN 'Excellent (80-100)'
        WHEN health_score >= 60 THEN 'Good (60-79)'
        WHEN health_score >= 40 THEN 'Fair (40-59)'
        ELSE 'Poor (0-39)'
    END as health_category,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(lifetime_value)::numeric, 0) as avg_ltv,
    ROUND(AVG(monthly_revenue)::numeric, 0) as avg_monthly_revenue
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
  AND updated_at >= [[{{time_period}}]]
GROUP BY health_category
ORDER BY MIN(health_score) DESC

cards.name: Expansion Opportunities
cards.description: Customers with high health scores and expansion potential

native.query:
SELECT 
    customer_name,
    health_score,
    current_plan,
    monthly_revenue,
    expansion_potential,
    last_interaction_date,
    csm_assigned
FROM customer_health 
WHERE status = 'active'
  AND health_score >= 75
  AND expansion_potential > 0
  AND ({{customer_segment}} IS NULL OR segment = {{customer_segment}})
ORDER BY expansion_potential DESC, health_score DESC
LIMIT 15
